header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Mir Muhammad Nohri advocate for the petitioner.
body: 1. Urgency granted 2-4 Through this petition, the petitioner prays that respondents be directed to complete demarcation process, for which he has already paid the required fees. Learned A.A.G appearing in other cases waives notice of the petition and submits that respondents are under objection to decide the application for demarcation of land in accordance with law.

In view of above situation, the instant petition stands disposed of with direction to the respondent No.3 to redress the grievance of the petitioner within a period of thirty (30) days in accordance with law.
